texts.preamble: Ravi Goyal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 30 December, 2024 Author: Dwarka Dhish Bansal Bench: Dwarka Dhish Bansal 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Gwalior Crr No. 6427 of 2024 (Ravi Goyal Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Dated : 30-12-2024 Shri Anshu Gupta - Advocate for the petitioner. Shri Prabhakar Kushwah - Panel Lawyer for the respondent
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner argued that the Courts below have wrongly appreciated the evidence and convicted the petitioner. It is further submitted that the petitioner was on bail during trial and he never misused the liberty. It is further submitted that petitioner is permanent resident of District Morena (M.P.). Petitioner has suffered sufficient incarceration. Fine amount has already been deposited. Present criminal revision is likely to take long time to conclude. Therefore, it has been prayed that the petitioner be released on bail. On the other hand, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the petitioner and prayed for its rejection.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner argued that the Courts below have wrongly appreciated the evidence and convicted the petitioner. It is further submitted that the petitioner was on bail during trial and he never misused the liberty. It is further submitted that petitioner is permanent resident of District Morena (M.P.). Present criminal revision is likely to take long time to conclude. Therefore, it has been prayed that the petitioner be released on bail.
texts.respondent_arguments: Petitioner has suffered sufficient incarceration. Fine amount has already been deposited. On the other hand, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the petitioner and prayed for its rejection.
